subject: Request to replace SWE III, Inference Runtime — headcount + comp-band exception
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Katie Sun <katie@talentpath.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to replace SWE III, Inference Runtime — headcount + comp-band exception

Hi team,

Quick context: Rohit (SWE III on Inference Runtime) gave notice last week; last day is 7/2. This role is critical for the low-latency KV-cache work and we need coverage ASAP. Hiring plan below:

- Role: Software Engineer III (inference runtime, GPU stack)
- Preferred start window: early August (post-offer acceptance + 2-3 week notice)
- Headcount: backfill 1 FTE (replace vacancy)
- Comp ask: hiring manager requests a band exception — targeting top of band for SWE III or low SWE IV comp for exceptional candidate (see business case).

Attached: backfill_business_case.pdf (impact metrics + sprint risk), team_org_chart.png.

Requesting:
1) Approval to refill the headcount (replace Rohit) — this is a backfill not a net-new.
2) Pre-approval to submit a comp-band exception up to $185k base / competitive equity and a capped sign-on up to $25k if candidate requires.
3) Go-ahead for Katie/TalentPath to surface strong candidates; give recruiter green light to move to verbal offer if candidate matches qualifications.

Why exception: the work is highly specialized (optimizations across quantized kernels) and we've had two recent offers declined when constrained to midpoint of SWE III band. Business case outlines potential SLO risk (~12% latency regression risk if not staffed).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick sync.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Engineering Manager, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments (referenced): backfill_business_case.pdf, team_org_chart.png

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Katie Sun <katie@talentpath.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to replace SWE III, Inference Runtime — headcount + comp-band exception

Thanks Marissa — quick clarifying questions before I route to finance and comp committee:

1) Role scope: is this strictly IC work or do you expect any team lead/coaching responsibilities that would push this toward a SWE IV profile?
2) Can you share target total comp (base + equity + sign-on) you're comfortable with if we cannot approve a base band exception?
3) Any budget constraints from the org (this is a backfill but we need to confirm the cost center can absorb the uplift).

If you can reply with the bullet answers I'll get this into today's comp committee packet (cutoff 4pm PT).

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
Director, Platform Finance (comp and budgeting)

Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to replace SWE III, Inference Runtime — headcount + comp-band exception

Marissa — I read the business case. Approve refill of the headcount. We cannot have that risk through Q3.

On the comp exception: I approve escalation to comp committee for up to $185k base + up to $25k sign-on as an exception, provided the hiring manager commits to the following guardrails:
- Offer cap at $185k base (no discretionary overrun)
- Equity to remain within compounded range for SWE III with a maximum 25% uplift relative to midpoint
- Sign-on only if candidate requires it to offset forfeited equity/notice cost

Please track the final ask in HR-TICKET-4721 and loop Laura for final sign-off. Katie — proceed with candidate outreach; do not extend any verbal offer > $180k until we have comp committee note in writing.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to replace SWE III, Inference Runtime — headcount + comp-band exception

Thanks — looping in comp committee guidance. Summary:

- SWE III band (US) midpoint: $142k; band range: $120k–$165k.
- Committee will approve one-off exception to $185k base for this role given the retention/risk impact and market scarcity for this specialty. Approval is conditional on manager justification (already provided) and the hiring manager committing to a hiring scorecard and 3 reference checks.
- Equity: recommend using a spot equity grant at hire that keeps annualized budget neutral within the group (I attached comp_band_table.xlsx).
- Sign-on: allowed up to $25k but requires CFO notification if used.

Next steps for Marissa: please upload the finalized offer template to HR-TICKET-4721, include the hiring scorecard link, and reply here with the precise package you intend to put on the table so we can lock it in the comp committee minutes.

Attachments: comp_band_table.xlsx

—Laura
Laura Bennett
People Partner (Engineering)
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2026 08:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to replace SWE III, Inference Runtime — headcount + comp-band exception

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turn. Final package we will move forward with if candidate checks all boxes (technical scorecard, references, on-time start):

- Base: $182,000
- Equity: 0.40% (spot grant at start, annualized ratchet to group budget)
- Sign-on: $20,000 (to cover forfeited bonus at prior employer)
- Title: Software Engineer III (no manager duties)
- Offer cap: do not exceed $185k base as per Jonas' guardrail; recruiter to pause verbal if candidate demands > $180k until we have the comp minutes on file.

Katie — please proceed to submit candidate shortlist and move to verbal if market aligns. I will upload the hiring scorecard and draft offer language to HR-TICKET-4721 this morning.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Engineering Manager, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference
